title: Tesla’s robotaxis are moving in reverse
summary: The number of paid robotaxi miles traveled fell 36% in the second quarter, despite expanding to new cities, according to Tesla's own figures.
llm_summary: Tesla's robotaxi service has seen a significant decline in the number of paid miles traveled, dropping 36% in the second quarter. This decline occurred despite the expansion of the service to new cities. The drop in robotaxi usage could be a concern for Tesla's autonomous driving ambitions and future revenue streams.
